questions: Have you had episodes of these facial movements before today?
Do the episodes also occur when you are not undergoing a procedure?
Do you remain fully aware throughout each episode?
Can you voluntarily stop the movements, even briefly?
Do you feel an urge or mounting tension before the movements?
Do you feel relief after making the movements?
Are the movements worse with stress or anxiety?
Are the movements triggered by bright light?
Do the movements occur while you are asleep?
Do the movements always affect both sides of your face?
Do the movements ever involve your tongue, jaw, or mouth independently of the eye and forehead movements?
Have you ever had weakness, numbness, speech difficulty, or loss of balance during or after an episode?
Have you ever lost consciousness during one of these episodes?
Have you ever bitten your tongue or lost bladder control during one of these episodes?
Have you recently started or increased a medication for nausea, psychiatric symptoms, or movement problems?
Have you ever been diagnosed with a tic disorder, dystonia, seizures, or another neurological condition?
Has anyone in your family had similar facial movements?
Have these episodes been progressively worsening over time?
